column1: # Curated food catalogue for the nutrition feature.
# One line per food. `id` is permanent: a logged meal stores it, so renumbering here would
# silently repoint every meal ever logged at a different food. Add new foods at the end with
# the next free id; never reorder or reuse one.
# `fdcId` is the USDA FoodData Central record the numbers come from (SR Legacy, public domain).
# `name` is the display string and doubles as its i18n key. `cat` is one of
# protein | dairy | carb | veg | fruit | fat | drink.
# The last field is the USDA description the id resolves to, kept so a wrong match is visible
# in review rather than only in the app. gen_foods.mjs ignores it.
# The list is curated rather than filtered. SR Legacy holds 7,793 records, most of which are
# brand-name products, restaurant dishes and 954 cuts of beef; a rules-only filter over it
# produces a catalogue full of things nobody logs. These are the foods people actually eat.
